column1: #  - a function definition or prototype at file or namespace scope is function; in a class body, with a qualified name (Sensor::read), or as a constructor, destructor (named with the ~) or operator, it is method;
#  - class, struct, union and enum (also enum class) with a body are class; `typedef struct { } Name;` is class Name; other typedefs and `using Name = ...` are type_alias; namespace is package;
#  - #define NAME is constant and #define NAME(args) is function;

#  - a declaration at file or namespace scope (also inside #if / #else) is constant when its type says const or constexpr (a pointer to const too) and variable otherwise; arrays, pointers, `int a = 1, b = 2;` count; `Servo myServo;` is variable;
#  - fields of a class, struct or union are field;
#  - locals, parameters, enumerators and a forward declaration of a type (`class Led;`) are not definitions.
